items.title: URLs or texts
items.description: One QR code per line: a URL, any text, or a special format such as WIFI:T:WPA;S:MyNetwork;P:secret;; or a vCard. Via the API you can also pass objects {"text": "…", "name": "file-name"}.

format.title: File format
format.description: PNG for web and documents, SVG for print and design tools.

size.title: PNG size (px)
size.description: Width and height of each PNG, quiet zone included.

style.title: Style
style.description: Shape of the modules. Finder squares stay solid so every scanner reads them.

foreground.title: Foreground colour
foreground.description: Hex colour of the code, e.g. #000000. Keep it darker than the background.

background.title: Background colour
background.description: Hex colour behind the code, e.g. #ffffff.

transparent.title: Transparent background
transparent.description: No background at all (PNG with alpha, SVG without a rect). Overrides the background colour.

logoUrl.title: Logo URL
logoUrl.description: Optional image (PNG, JPG, SVG, WebP) placed in the middle of every code. Error correction switches to H automatically.

margin.title: Quiet zone (modules)
margin.description: Empty border around the code. 4 is the standard; less can fail on some scanners.

errorCorrection.title: Error correction
enumTitles: Auto (M, or H with a logo)
errorCorrection.description: How much damage the code survives. Higher means denser codes.

zip.title: Bundle into one ZIP
zip.description: Also save every file in qr-codes.zip (when there is more than one item).
